assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The payer stated that the clinical criteria for this specific diagnostic modality were not met.
